message: 縁

name: Helena
message: 「Anyway, Nanaka-chan was so cool」

name: Helena
message: 「If she were a rugged guy, I would've fallen for her」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is that so」

name: Helena
message: 「So, Azel-chan didn't come here, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes」

name: Helena
message: 「Really?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is something the matter?」

name: Helena
message: 「Tamiko-chan's work is flawless」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed it is」

name: Helena
message: 「Though, she didn't point out the one possibility that someone might be sheltering Azel-chan」

name: Helena
message: 「I think she'll be found within two or three days」

name: Melilot
message: 「I suppose so」

name: Helena
message: 「Well then, let me know if Azel-chan shows up」

name: Melilot
message: 「I understand」
As closing time arrives, Melilot locks the door.

name: Melilot
message: 「Has your fever gone down?」

name: Azel
message: 「It went down after I stayed put and read the book I borrowed yesterday」
The two walk between the bookshelves, returning books that had been placed in the wrong spots back to where they belong.
Melilot explains how Riesling conducts her work,

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems my friend's work is flawless」

name: Melilot
message: 「It also appears she has already deduced that you are here」

name: Azel
message: 「Aside from Synn, you're the only person I'm close to, after all」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm not one to talk, but you really should have built up a wider network of connections」

name: Azel
message: 「If you tell me to leave, I'll leave」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't want to be a burden」

name: Melilot
message: 「As long as one is alive, one is bound to be a burden to others」

name: Melilot
message: 「Besides, you're no burden at all. I'm sheltering you here of my own free will」

name: Azel
message: 「Heh」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is something the matter?」

name: Azel
message: 「No, I was just thinking how strange it is」

name: Melilot
message: 「What is?」

name: Azel
message: 「When we first met, I thought you were an unpleasant person」

name: Melilot
message: 「You mean me, right」

name: Azel
message: 「That's right」

name: Melilot
message: 「I thought you were quite the impudent transfer student myself」

name: Azel
message: 「And yet, here we are now, sorting through books together like this. And not because I was ordered to, either--I'm doing it voluntarily」

name: Melilot
message: 「I assumed it was because you were afraid of me」
Azel's hands stopped.

name: Melilot
message: 「Is something the matter?」

name: Azel
message: 「For some reason, that made me feel sad」

name: Melilot
message: 「Did you just remember something about Sakura」

name: Azel
message: 「N-No. Well, I think about that all the time, though」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Let's pretend I didn't hear that」

name: Azel
message: 「T-That's not what I meant just now! It really isn't!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then what did you mean?」

name: Azel
message: 「I meant the fact that you thought of me that way, Melilot」
Melilot stopped what he was doing as well.

name: Melilot
message: 「What do you mean by that?」
Azel looked up at Melilot.

name: Azel
message: 「I'm doing this not because I'm afraid of you, but because I'm fond of you」

name: Azel
message: 「It saddens me that you mistook it for fear」

name: Azel
message: 「Being with you is fun, Melilot. It's a different kind of fun from being with Synn, or the Student Council and the people around them...」

name: Azel
message: 「With my poor vocabulary, I can't put it into words well, but... I think... perhaps this is what it's like when a younger sister adores an older sister she's close to」

name: Azel
message: 「F-forget I said that! This is just a one-sided, irrational feeling」
Azel turned her face away and resumed organizing the bookshelf.

name: Azel
message: 「How shameless of me. Even though we've only known each other for a few months and I rely on you so much, I keep dodging the most important things」

name: Azel
message: 「I keep saying I'll tell you, yet I don't even try to, putting it off over and over. You must hate being looked up to by someone like that. So forget it」

name: Melilot
message: 「...You're mistaken」

name: Azel
message: 「Huh?」
Melilot's hand reached out and rearranged the book Azel had just put away.

name: Azel
message: 「Sorry...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm only joking」

name: Azel
message: 「W-what is?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because I feel the same way」

name: Melilot
message: 「Thinking, so this is what having a younger sister is like」

name: Azel
message: 「Forget it... You don't have to force yourself to say things like that」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even I have things I'm torn about whether I should tell you. So you don't need to worry about it」

name: Azel
message: 「You do...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Let's set aside the generalization that everyone has secrets for now」

name: Melilot
message: 「Knowing that I'm hiding something from you, have your feelings changed?」
Azel silently shook her head.

name: Melilot
message: 「Then that settles it」

name: Melilot
message: 「Besides, a friend of mine once told me, 'You have to cherish what you feel. Killing or ignoring it with logic is the worst! You've got to enjoy life!'」

name: Azel
message: 「...That's a good friend」

name: Melilot
message: 「I won't say it in front of them since it would go to their heads, though」

name: Azel
message: 「I... actually like those guys in the Student Council quite a bit, too」

name: Melilot
message: 「I won't tell a soul」

name: Azel
message: 「Thank you」

name: Melilot
message: 「And what about Sakura-kun?」

name: Azel
message: 「That man and I are...」
Tears suddenly welled up and overflowed from Azel's eyes.
Melilot casually averted her gaze.

name: Paqy
message: 「That's rough, man」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well. I get how you feel, Demon Lord, though」
If I leave it to Riesling-san, she might be able to find Azel.
Besides, I didn't really think coming to look would tell me anything, yet I couldn't stop myself from coming to see it anyway.
Right here, I fought Sengenin-sensei to protect Azel...
Awakened as the Demon Lord... and Azel found out I was the Demon Lord...

name: Melphas
message: 「She was crying right over there, you know」
When I turned around--

name: Melphas
message: 「Good evening, young Student Council President」

name: Synn
message: 「When... was that?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Two days ago, so it was late at night on December 16th」
That's earlier than when Eauderourke saw Azel.

name: Synn
message: 「She was crying...?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Lovers' quarrels are all part of romance, and being played by crocodile tears is part of the game of love, too, yet you must never make a girl cry」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't understand」

name: Melphas
message: 「A woman's heart is difficult to fathom. Though, regardless of whether one is a man or a woman, the depths of one's own heart are hard enough to understand even for oneself」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't understand why Azel was crying」
Why was she crying beside me while I slept?
And after leaving me, why was she crying in this place?

name: Melphas
message: 「In my humble opinion, if it was neither out of joy nor from dust or some irritant getting in her eyes, then it must have been because she was sad」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's genuinely a stupid thought」

name: Melphas
message: 「There is no point in shedding crocodile tears where no one else is watching, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「...Azel isn't clever enough to fake cry like that」

name: Melphas
message: 「Indeed, I would imagine so. Had she been so clever, she likely would not have taken on such heavy karma」

name: Synn
message: 「Karma?」

name: Melphas
message: 「All I can say is that she stood rooted to the spot there, weeping without making a sound」
Azel had slumped down here, watching the battle between me and Soltia.
So her crying and her disappearing have to be connected.
Is it because I'm the Demon Lord after all?
Nanaka told me I wasn't, and everyone else accepted me too... yet it always comes back to that.

name: Melphas
message: 「If I may add one personal impression, when she was crying, she looked every bit like an ordinary girl」

name: Melphas
message: 「She looked nothing at all like someone who would destroy the world--just a fragile, fleeting girl who seemed as though she might break at the slightest touch」

name: Synn
message: 「Destroy the world... Please stop making weird jokes」

name: Melphas
message: 「'As if she were the legendary Demon Lord,' is that what you're thinking?」
Does this person know?
Just like Virus knew--that I'm the Demon Lord.

name: Synn
message: 「The Demon Lord doesn't destroy the world」

name: Melphas
message: 「I am well aware. After all, I have heard that the Demon Lord saves the world」

name: Synn
message: 「Saves the world...? The Demon Lord...?」
That was news to me.

name: Melphas
message: 「Is that not the case, Great Sage Paqy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch, so you figured me out, huh」

name: Melphas
message: 「Unexpected truths often lurk within words whispered in bed, mingled with seductive sighs and damp pillow talk」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that true, Paqy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It wasn't just sighs and pillow talk, man. There were boobs too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Not that part! Does the Demon Lord actually save the world?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It ain't an obligation or anything. You don't have to save it. Just do whatever you want.」

name: Synn
message: 「In the first place, save it from what?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hmm?」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you forget?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I think I'll remember eventually.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Have you, the Student Council President, been on a date with her yet?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What are you saying all of a sudden?!」

name: Melphas
message: 「If the world perishes, there can be no sweet, luscious confessions, no bittersweet, heart-throbbing dates, and no bashful yet innocent whispers of love. Wouldn't you agree?」

name: Melphas
message: 「It would be splendid if you could magnificently save the world while indulging in a bittersweet romance with her. After all, that is the very definition of a perfect happy ending that wrings tears of blood from the masses.」
